description: Bitly turns long URLs into branded short links and QR codes, then shows how they perform. Connect your Bitly account to create and manage short links, generate and customize QR codes, build Bitly Sites (link-in-bio pages), and pull click, scan, and site analytics across your links, groups, and organization — all without leaving the conversation.
